Also note: front matter `title:` changes the output slug (slug is derived from the title), so prefer adding an explicit `slug:` too, or verify how you map input file -> output file.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render a set of markdown files through a marmite binary, isolating content.html output.

Usage: mdrender.py <binary> <dir-with-md-files> <outdir>
Creates a temp site whose content.html template is exactly `{{ content.html }}`
so each generated <slug>.html is the raw rendered markdown body.
"""
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

def render(binary, mddir, outdir, extra_files=None, config=None, args=()):
    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="mdr-")
    tdir = os.path.join(work, "templates")
    os.makedirs(tdir)
    with open(os.path.join(tdir, "content.html"), "w") as f:
        f.write("{{ content.html }}")
    with open(os.path.join(tdir, "list.html"), "w") as f:
        f.write("")
    with open(os.path.join(tdir, "group.html"), "w") as f:
        f.write("")
    for name in os.listdir(mddir):
        if name.endswith(".md"):
            shutil.copy(os.path.join(mddir, name), os.path.join(work, name))
    if config:
        with open(os.path.join(work, "marmite.yaml"), "w") as f:
            f.write(config)
    site = os.path.join(work, "_site")
    p = subprocess.run([binary, work, site, *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    if os.path.isdir(site):
        for name in os.listdir(site):
            if name.endswith(".html") and name not in ("404.html",):
                shutil.copy(os.path.join(site, name), os.path.join(outdir, name))
    shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    return p

if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = render(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
    if p.returncode != 0:
        sys.stderr.write(p.stdout + p.stderr)
        sys.exit(p.returncode)

import os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

BIN = os.environ.get("MARMITE", "/tmp/orig/marmite_ref")
AUX = {}  # extra templates always written

def build(tpl, aux=None, config=None, md=None, args=(), keep=False):

    t = os.path.join(work, "templates"); os.makedirs(t)

    for n in ("list.html", "group.html"):
        with open(os.path.join(t, n), "w") as f: f.write("")
    for k, v in (aux or {}).items():
        p = os.path.join(t, k); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
        with open(p, "w") as f: f.write(v)
    with open(os.path.join(work, "probe.md"), "w") as f:
        f.write(md if md is not None else "---\ntitle: Probe\nslug: probe\n---\nBODY\n")
    if config: 
        with open(os.path.join(work, "marmite.yaml"), "w") as f: f.write(config)
    site = os.path.join(work, "_site")

    out = None
    fp = os.path.join(site, "probe.html")
    if os.path.exists(fp):
        out = open(fp).read()
    r = (p.returncode, out, p.stdout, p.stderr, work)
    if not keep: shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    return r

def render(tpl, **kw):
    rc, out, so, se, w = build(tpl, **kw)
    if out is None:
        return None, (so + se)
    return out, None

MARK = "§"
def batch(cases, **kw):
    """cases: list of (id, snippet). Returns dict id->rendered or raises."""
    tpl = "".join("[[%s]]%s[[/%s]]\n" % (i, s, i) for i, s in cases)
    out, err = render(tpl, **kw)
    if out is None:
        return None, err
    res = {}
    for i, s in cases:
        m = re.search(re.escape("[[%s]]" % i) + "(.*?)" + re.escape("[[/%s]]" % i), out, re.S)
        res[i] = m.group(1) if m else "<<MISSING>>"
    return res, None

def one(snippet, **kw):
    """render single snippet, return (value, err)"""
    r, err = batch([("X", snippet)], **kw)
    if r is None: return None, err
    return r["X"], None

def show(v):

    return repr(v)

if __name__ == "__main__":

    if out is None or "Failed to parse" in se or "Failed to load template content.html" in se:

def batch(cases, **kw):
    tpl = "".join("[[%s]]%s[[/%s]]\n" % (i, s, i) for i, s in cases)

    e = e or ""

    m = re.findall(r'"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"', e)
